goal: Reject negative and NaN wait timeouts passed to the node mining interface with an explicit error
Prevent bad IPC inputs from crashing debug builds or causing unintended wait durations in release builds
agreement: Support for preventing debug-build crashes and invalid wait deadlines (ryanofsky)
Suggested returning errors instead of clamping to zero and extending tests (Sjors)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because it hardens the mining IPC interface against invalid wait deadlines and debug assertion aborts
Benefit is limited because no known mining clients currently send negative or NaN timeouts
